turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance, you're speaking with Marcus. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, a stone cracked my windscreen and I'm stressed about the cost. How much would I have to pay?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm really sorry you're going through this, I can imagine how worrying that is. Can I take your full name and date of birth, please?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Tomas Herrera, 11 February 1966.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you have a cracked windscreen and want to understand what you'd pay. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is it only the windscreen that's damaged?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, just the windscreen.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, I've recorded all of that on your file.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just so you know, any settlement will be subject to the policy excess and the indemnity limit, and we may pursue subrogation against the other party's insurer.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sorry, I don't follow, what does any of that mean?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It's all in the policy wording, I'm afraid. Anyway, let's move on.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me just check that for you, would you mind if I place you on a brief hold?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sure, no problem.

turns.speaker: SYSTEM
turns.text: [On hold 1:30]

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for holding, Mr Herrera, I appreciate your patience. For windscreen-only claims the excess, which is the amount you pay towards a claim yourself, is $50. For other motor claims it's $250.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, that's good to know.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Mr Herrera. I've noted your query under reference REQ-48696, and the claims team will contact you if you'd like to proceed.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've explained the excess that applies.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance, Mr Herrera. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
